items.item_text: Bachelor's degree in related area and/or equivalent experience and training.
Student services and administrative experience in higher education setting.
Experience using FileMaker Pro, Excel, Word, electronic communications and web editing.

Experience interpreting and applying policies and practices related to administration of graduate academic student programs, admissions, student academic progress, financial aid, outreach and recruitment, and program requirements and procedures.
Knowledge of the graduate student experience, administration in higher education and at UC Davis and knowledge of campus resources.
Knowledge and experience to make recommendations on exceptions to academic policy and enforcement of existing policy, and achieve divisional goals.

Under general supervision of the Director of Student Services, manage two complex and comprehensive graduate programs, the department-based Masters in the School of Education, and the PhD Graduate Group in Education including administrative and financial management, academic advising and program development. Responsible for program management, including internal and external financial awards, administration of work study awards, program reviews, and academic advising. Design and deliver academic advising services and programs utilizing innovative uses of technology, including admissions and enrollment. Develop and coordinate educational enhancement services and programs, managing professional development seminar, outreach and recruitment. Provide proactive advisement, monitor progress from matriculation through degree conferral. Develop, analyze and interpret admission, recruitment, curriculum and advising services policy. This position works under general programmatic supervision of the Graduate Group in Education (GGE) chair with a high degree of independence and autonomy on a day-to-day basis.
Ability to effectively problem solve and develop solutions independently.
Knowledge of the academic environment of a major research university and the demands on students and faculty; familiarity with the issues confronting students.
Planning and organizational skills to administer and oversee complex projects independently and as a team leader.

Skills to analyze complex problems or issues relating to administrative matters, faculty governance, undergraduate education, or individual student circumstances occurring within a university context.
Interpersonal skills and political acumen to communicate in an effective manner, and handle difficult, sensitive and/or confidential issues.
